keyFindings.description: common.sh:125: each waiting caller opens descriptor 9 on .run.lock before flock, so lock_holders (fd 9 scan) lists other waiters as holders; with the real holder in another PID namespace, a concurrent caller is refused naming a waiter, without 'not visible' or 'Do not remove .run.lock' (reproduced 4 of 6). Try on another descriptor and dup to 9 only after flock succeeds; add a two-waiter case.

common.sh:142-157: the refusal re-checks the record after the loop (a holder that exits in between is reported as still holding), says 'in its own PID namespace' for a same-namespace or pidns-less record, and 'wrote its record in another PID namespace' for a record with no pidns. No test covers the pidns comparison.
